scope: HullDamage/static boss heat, direct caller/update paths and separate small impact effect; no general or native-log restart

observations.finding: addPersistentHullFire keeps the array bounded; the boss health formula caps the normal limit at eight. Even at cap/duplicate, it returns a fresh array; a nearby hit replaces a site with an updated revision/power. No unbounded persistent-site list follows from this code.

The boss uses stable site.id keys and id-based profiles. Re-rendering is not proof of remounting. When rendering, appearance recomputes a profile per site, which includes a small spark array even for a static mark. Render frequency/retention/native cost are not measured.

Boss static heat disables hotspot/inner animations and speck content; original geometry/transforms and two opacity stages remain. The flat-fill builder changes only inner background paint; neither the layer nor its React updates is removed.
HullDamage receives sites, latest hit, mask URL and boss damage. Original inline mask style is still present even when active standard/WebKit masks are overridden to none.
Hits continue updating the bounded simulation-side hullFires array, independent of the static-fill CSS. No gameplay/site-update change was part of the delivered candidate.
The heat div and keyed FinishedEffect mini-explosion are siblings. The flat-fill selector targets inner heat b only; it does not disable the separate mini-explosion gradients, sparks or lifecycle.

Completion inspects native subtree animations and may render null. A changed hit key also replaces the previous effect. This source inspection does not show an ever-growing set of impact elements or prove any native failure.

decision.firstStep: Match the completed-run report to the delivered source/tree/options and last saved state.
decision.conditionalInference: Only if source f67fd2e4 is confirmed does this add a failed uniform-fill condition. Then gradient replacement alone is insufficient; do not label gradients, mask, reflection, touch, heat or a leak as the proven sole cause.
decision.nextScope: After matching, choose one small comparison within the remaining static-layer presentation/update path. Do not disable mini-explosions, gameplay and heat together or publish a speculative permanent repair.
